concepts.name: Stupidity
concepts.description: Low intelligence or a lack of intellectual ability, as a general trait.

concepts.name: Ignorance
concepts.description: Lack of knowledge, education or awareness of the facts.

concepts.name: Dullness
concepts.description: Slowness of wit or understanding; failure to grasp what is plain.

concepts.name: Irrationality
concepts.description: Thinking or behaving against reason; being governed by impulse, prejudice or delusion.

concepts.name: Flawed reasoning
concepts.description: Arguments or claims that fail logically, evidentially or methodologically.

concepts.name: Nonsense
concepts.description: Speech, writing or ideas lacking sense, substance or truth; also absurdity.

concepts.name: Foolishness
concepts.description: Silliness and lack of sense in behaviour, as opposed to low intelligence in general.

concepts.name: Gullibility
concepts.description: Readiness to be fooled or to believe without checking.

concepts.name: Poor judgment
concepts.description: Bad decisions and failure to weigh consequences sensibly.

concepts.name: Impulsiveness
concepts.description: Acting on whim without thought or restraint.

concepts.name: Lack of self-awareness
concepts.description: Failure to see one's own limits, faults or effect on others.

concepts.name: Pedantry
concepts.description: Excessive concern with minor rules, details or displays of learning.

concepts.name: Irrelevance
concepts.description: Material that has no bearing on the matter at hand.

concepts.name: Evasiveness
concepts.description: Avoiding direct answers or responsibility.

concepts.name: Arrogance
concepts.description: Overbearing pride and a sense of superiority over others.

concepts.name: Vanity
concepts.description: Excessive pride in one's own appearance, talents or importance.

concepts.name: Pretentiousness
concepts.description: Claiming or displaying importance, culture or skill one does not have.

concepts.name: Excessive confidence
concepts.description: Certainty out of proportion to ability or evidence.

concepts.name: Boastfulness
concepts.description: Bragging; loud or repeated self-praise.

concepts.name: Condescension
concepts.description: Treating others as inferiors; patronising manner.

concepts.name: Insolence
concepts.description: Disrespect toward people owed respect; cheek and impudence.

concepts.name: Shamelessness
concepts.description: Lack of embarrassment about conduct that deserves it.

concepts.name: Dishonesty
concepts.description: General untruthfulness and lack of integrity.

concepts.name: Deception
concepts.description: Actively misleading others through lies, tricks or false impressions.

concepts.name: Hypocrisy
concepts.description: Professing standards one does not follow.

concepts.name: Fraudulence
concepts.description: Fakery and falsely claiming to be what one is not; swindling.

concepts.name: Treachery
concepts.description: Betrayal of trust, loyalty or allegiance.

concepts.name: Corruption
concepts.description: Abuse of position or trust for improper gain.

concepts.name: Wickedness
concepts.description: Moral badness; villainy and wrongdoing.

concepts.name: Malice
concepts.description: Active ill will; a wish to harm or distress others.

concepts.name: Greed
concepts.description: Excessive desire for money, goods or advantage.

concepts.name: Stinginess
concepts.description: Unwillingness to spend or share.

concepts.name: Selfishness
concepts.description: Concern for oneself at others' expense.

concepts.name: Ingratitude
concepts.description: Failure to appreciate or acknowledge help received.

concepts.name: Sycophancy
concepts.description: Fawning and servile flattery to win favour.

concepts.name: Slander
concepts.description: False or malicious statements about others, and backbiting.

concepts.name: Meddling
concepts.description: Intrusive interference in others' affairs.

concepts.name: Cowardice
concepts.description: Lack of courage in the face of danger or difficulty.

concepts.name: Weakness
concepts.description: Lack of strength of will or character; spinelessness.

concepts.name: Laziness
concepts.description: Unwillingness to work or exert effort.

concepts.name: Stubbornness
concepts.description: Obstinate refusal to change one's mind or course, including rigid dogmatism.

concepts.name: Intemperance
concepts.description: Lack of restraint, especially in drink, appetite or conduct.

concepts.name: Incompetence
concepts.description: Lack of the skill or ability to do a job properly.

concepts.name: Clumsiness
concepts.description: Awkwardness in movement, handling or social situations.

concepts.name: Uselessness
concepts.description: Being of no practical value or use.

concepts.name: Failure
concepts.description: Failing to succeed; being a loser or a botch.

concepts.name: Mediocrity
concepts.description: Being merely average or second-rate.

concepts.name: Negligence
concepts.description: Failure to take proper care or perform a duty.

concepts.name: Recklessness
concepts.description: Disregard of risk or consequences.

concepts.name: Unreliability
concepts.description: Not being dependable; failing to follow through.

concepts.name: Obstruction
concepts.description: Deliberately delaying, blocking or frustrating a process.

concepts.name: Tactlessness
concepts.description: Saying or doing the wrong thing without regard for others' feelings.

concepts.name: Hostility
concepts.description: Unfriendliness and aggression toward others.

concepts.name: Pettiness
concepts.description: Fixation on trivial matters; small-mindedness.

concepts.name: Obnoxiousness
concepts.description: Being objectionable and unpleasant to be around.

concepts.name: Rudeness
concepts.description: Lack of manners and consideration.

concepts.name: Irritability
concepts.description: Being easily annoyed; peevishness.

concepts.name: Complaining
concepts.description: Whining and habitual grumbling.

concepts.name: Verbosity
concepts.description: Using too many words; rambling.

concepts.name: Tediousness
concepts.description: Being boring, trite or wearisome.

concepts.name: Slovenliness
concepts.description: Untidiness and carelessness about appearance or work.

concepts.name: Baseness
concepts.description: Moral or social lowness; contemptible character.

concepts.name: Contrariness
concepts.description: Disposition to oppose or quarrel for its own sake.
